summary: Haoxi Health Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held July 6, 2026 in Beijing. Shareholders approved a special resolution to reduce the par value of outstanding Class A and Class B ordinary shares from US$0.32 to US$0.0000001 per share, subdivide authorized but unissued shares, and transfer the resulting credit to a distributable reserve. The proposal also reduced authorized share capital from US$35.2 trillion to US$11 million. All other routine resolutions (e.g., bylaw amendments) were approved. This is an ordinary capital restructuring, not an event-driven special situation.
